note: East of the Jordan, given by Moses at the tribe's request for its cattle land (Numbers 32): from Aroer on the river Arnon north across the plain of Medeba to Heshbon.
East of the Jordan in Gilead: Jazer and the cities of Gilead from Heshbon to Mahanaim, with the Jordan valley up to the sea of Chinnereth.

Joseph's descendants were divided into Ephraim and Manasseh; half of Manasseh (the Machirites) received Bashan, the former kingdom of Og, and half of Gilead east of the Jordan, including the towns of Jair.
The other half of Manasseh settled west of the Jordan between Ephraim and the Jezreel valley, reaching the sea; it held Beth-shean, Taanach, Megiddo and Dor but could not drive out their Canaanites.
Joseph's younger son received the central hill country (mount Ephraim) north of Benjamin, with some cities inside Manasseh; the Canaanites of Gezer were not driven out.
A small territory between Judah and Joseph, including Jericho, Bethel, Gibeon, Ramah and Jebusi (Jerusalem).
The largest allotment, from the wilderness of Zin to the border of Benjamin, including Hebron, given to Caleb; the Jebusites of Jerusalem were not driven out.
Received cities within Judah's inheritance, because Judah's portion was too much for them, including Beer-sheba in the south.
The original allotment lay west of Benjamin toward the sea by Japho (Joppa), including Zorah and Eshtaol; finding it too little, the Danites took Leshem (Laish) in the far north and renamed it Dan.
Lower Galilee between Issachar and Asher, beginning at Sarid, including a Beth-lehem distinct from the one in Judah.
The fertile Jezreel valley and its borders, including Jezreel and Shunem.
The north-western coast and its hills, reaching toward great Zidon and the strong city Tyre.
Upper Galilee west of the upper Jordan and the sea of Chinnereth, with fenced cities such as Chinnereth, Hazor and Kedesh.
Levi received no land allotment, for the LORD was their inheritance; instead the Levites were given 48 cities with their suburbs among the other tribes, six of them cities of refuge (Numbers 35:6-7).
